abstract: A 12-year-old girl with multiple lower-intestinal and urogenital tract anomalies and a past history of sacrococcygeal teratoma had an intramural mass of the ileum discovered as an incidental finding at surgery. The predominant mass had the features of the uterine fundus and two smaller contiguous nodules resembled the fallopian tube. A normal uterus and ovaries were observed at surgery. Somewhat similar lesions have been reported in the past in the ovary, ileum, scrotum, and possibly the bladder. Neither the metaplastic nor malformational theories are entirely satisfactory, yet they can be stated for most examples of heterotopias or choristomas.
abstract_ja: 多発性の下部消化管および泌尿生殖器の奇形と仙尾部奇形腫の既往を有する12歳女児において、回腸の壁内に腫瘤が手術中に偶然発見された。主な腫瘤は子宮底に類似した所見を示し、卵管に似た2つの小さな隣接結節を伴っていた。正常な子宮と卵巣は手術時に確認された。類似の病変は、過去に卵巣、回腸、陰嚢、膀胱などで報告されている。化生説も奇形説も完全には満足できるものではないが、ほとんどの異所性組織（choristoma）の例について両説を述べることができる。
